people.name: Cherethite
people.line: Member of Philistine tribe serving as royal guard

people.name: Gath
people.line: Philistine city; home of Goliath; refuge for David

people.name: Pelethites
people.line: Elite military unit loyal to King David

translations.web: All his servants passed on beside him; and all the Cherethites, and all the Pelethites, and all the Gittites, six hundred men who came after him from Gath, passed on before the king.
translations.bsb: and all his servants marched past him—all the Cherethites and Pelethites, and six hundred Gittites who had followed him from Gath.
translations.kjv: And all his servants passed on beside him; and all the Cherethites, and all the Pelethites, and all the Gittites, six hundred men which came after him from Gath, passed on before the king.
